title: Finite construction: PR1042 R480 sign normalization saves 408 primitives per orientation (no new kappa)
body:
On the frozen PR1042 R480 seven-slot word, Ross Richardson's retained sign compiler reduces the complete PR696 scalar comparison by **408 real-component primitives per orientation**: **149002 -> 148594** forward and **149018 -> 148610** backward. **Status: finite complex-supplier circuit construction. No new kappa.**

This adds only `research/selected-k8-sign-seed38/`. Both orientations, all 4,332 same-frame runs and all 713 arbitrary input columns are covered. A fresh basis at every run checks dirty-input boundary equality. Copies, clears, source-access order, shifts, per-register prefix envelopes and the complete paid profile remain unchanged. All final sign restorations are priced. A copy-fanout control demonstrates that the method can increase cost outside these pinned programs; no circuit-optimality claim is made.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/selected-k8-sign-seed38/check.py
python3 -I -O -B research/selected-k8-sign-seed38/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_SELECTED_K8_SIGN_PACKAGE runs=2166+2166 columns=713 saved=408/408 controls=120 no_new_kappa`, then four tests pass.

Separate Fraction and integer-dyadic implementations reproduce every receipt field and both full primitive streams. Validation includes 116 actual-run omissions/sign faults, four additional mathematical controls, 10,000 arithmetic differential steps, optimized minimal offline relocation, archive/source/receipt corruption, and rejection of both archived ancestors. `make selected-record-check`, 25 selected-record regressions and the whitespace check pass on Linux / CPython 3.12.3.

Exact base: **ba82555c64e1879e4b7decce28186f208fcb8262**. OS assignment seed **38**, complex-supplier track. The selected result at that base is PR1042, kappa 0.001672188119205421. Source archive: `research/community-frontier1042-audit/selected-replay.tar.gz`, SHA256 `22c3f4dce4b897a1d423d1388801933e288b6a6b1906cb15e1b16a5eb68db754`. Source pins bind four repository inputs, five named archive members and the frozen selection. Upstream advanced to PR1094; all four input pins still match the refreshed main tree. No transport to later words is claimed.

Credit **Ross Richardson / PR919** for the method and retained compiler; **Sagar Thakrar / PR696** for the lowering; and **Jeremy Kothe, Rohan Arun, Hao Yan, Chafik Boukhalfa, icekylinx, DreamingOfClouds, eumemic** and the retained construction lineage. The overlap refresh through PR1152 found distinct commuting-ADD work in PR1143 and capsule closure in PR1142. **woklerx / PR1132** exposed the retained R492 evidence trap during final inspection; the input was corrected to the actual `slots/local/` R480 archive members before any submission. Its pending code is not imported.

Native Clifford/frame execution, production integration, whole-call hosting, the global invoice and outer assembly were not rerun. The inherited all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, precision/tape, exact-recovery, analytic and bit-interface obligations remain. These finite scalar checks do not formally prove the multiplication theorem or establish a practical runtime improvement.

Contribution through **@Scratch-net with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance** in research, implementation, proof, verification and writing. The separate implementations are AI-assisted, not independent human review. Apache-2.0; predecessor files and licenses remain unchanged. No selected-frontier or `upstream/` edit.
